assertions.assertion: The service rendered was Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
The payer denied under Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with sick sinus syndrome, requiring continuous rhythm monitoring to evaluate for bradyarrhythmias or pauses
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The payer letter acknowledges that coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity
The indication note confirms the medical necessity of CPT 93229 for diagnosis codes I49.5 and Z86.73
